top_violation_types.title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operations director still lacked annual required training topics.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Recited: Four out of five staff files did not have the 24-hour pre-service training available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The driver's license copy on file for the center's driver was found to be expired at the time of  inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed in a walker in the infant       Note: The infant was removed and placed in the bouncer.

top_violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is serving a variety of snacks to children that do not have any nutritional value, and that exceed the allowed amount of sugar per the food program guidelines.

top_violation_types.title: Report Change in Controlling Person (26 TAC §746.305(a)(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Controlling person list is not being kept current.  Previous director no longer present at this center has not been removed as a controlling person.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three caregiver files were missing statements saying the caregiver has received the center's operational policies.
